baselineFindings.notes: All six visible think variants end the added forearm in a rounded stump on the chest without an upper-arm/shoulder connection. Squared neck tab visible; hard white jaw crescent on variants3/5.
All six wave variants have a separate raised forearm originating below the preview edge rather than a connected shoulder. Squared neck tabs visible.
Pico forearm folds into cheek and upper-arm contour disappears awkwardly. Replaced by coherent native whole-frame animation; historical manual rig does not receive final approval.

baselineFindings.subject: student
baselineFindings.notes: Raised page-turn hand and original lower-left book hand are both retained, alongside right hand: three visible hands. Retire or repair source frame before final approval.

manualCoverage.avatarScope: Seven configurations cover all six skin tones, every free hair/outfit/accessory option and bald/none; three poses and four actual open/closed animation phases. Not every possible combined custom-avatar permutation.

polishNotes.subject: hair3/jaw native edge
polishNotes.note: Thin white source-art halo remains visible against long hair. Shape and attachment stay stable. Root explicitly accepted as nonblocking native-art polish, not an anatomy-placement failure.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Retired sourceframe1; final playback[0,0,2,3] visibly has exactly two hands.
Replaced disconnected forearm with complete generated shoulder/upper-arm/elbow/forearm/hand silhouette and unified body transform.
Front head crop ends before lower neck; native lower neck is behind garment collar.
Registered foreground forearm occlusion excludes shoulder lobe.
429 native alpha pixels outside old crop restored with expanded viewport and preserved native scale/anchor.
Satchel moved to shoulder/chest, clearing outside raised forearm; all four final wave phases reviewed.
Active welcome and app characters use reviewed complete native pose frames.
